name: Cies
source:
A young man returns to the town full of recollections and dreams. A girl waits for him there. In the whirlpool of memories time slows down and feelings connect...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-december-2003-saya-no-uta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
青年回到那座满载回忆与梦想的小镇，一位少女正在那里等着他。在回忆的漩涡中，时间放慢了脚步，两人的心意渐渐相连……

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-december-2003-saya-no-uta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
